offering_description.value: Runs online auctions and yards that sell damaged, repossessed and end-of-life vehicles, mostly consigned by insurers, to dealers, rebuilders, exporters and other vehicle buyers. It earns fees from sellers and buyers and handles vehicle storage and title work.

primary_products.value: salvage vehicles; total-loss vehicles; used vehicles

primary_services.value: online vehicle auctions; vehicle storage and yard services; title processing; vehicle transport

items.detail: insurance companies, rental fleets, dealers, rebuilders, vehicle exporters

end_markets.value: automotive; insurance; vehicle remarketing; used vehicle trade

items.detail: seller and buyer fees on vehicle auction sales
yard storage, title and transport fees
sells vehicles on behalf of insurers and other sellers for a fee, to dealers and rebuilders
online auction platform connecting sellers and buyers
owns and operates vehicle yards and facilities where vehicles are stored and processed

geography_served.detail: US, Canada, UK, Brazil, Germany, Spain, United Arab Emirates and other countries

company-operated vehicle yards and auction sites
